title: A1
query: Find all proteins involved in the 'Muscle contraction' pathway.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (pw:Pathway {label: 'Muscle contraction'}) MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->pw WHERE p:Protein OR p:LightKinase OR p:LightIonChannel OR p:DarkKinase OR p:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS Protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE pw.label = 'Muscle contraction' RETURN DISTINCT p.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (pw:Pathway {label:'Muscle contraction'}), (pw)-[r:pathway_has_protein]->(prot:Protein) RETURN DISTINCT prot.label LIMIT 100

title: A2
query: Retrieve all functional domains associated with the 'KCNC2' protein.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE p.label = 'KCNC2' RETURN DISTINCT fd.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'KCNC2'})-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT fd.label AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'KCNC2'})-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT fd.label LIMIT 100

title: A3
query: List all diseases the protein 'CFTR' is implicated in.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein {label:'CFTR'})-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS disease LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label:'CFTR'}) MATCH (p)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT d.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (d:Disease)<-[:implicated_in]-(:Protein {label:'CFTR'})  RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS disease LIMIT 100

title: A4
query: Find all proteins interacting with the light ion channel 'KCNQ3'.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (lc:LightIonChannel {label:'KCNQ3'})-[:interact]-(p:Protein) RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (k:LightIonChannel {label: 'KCNQ3'}), (p:Protein)-[r:interact]-(k)  RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS proteinLabel  LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[r:interacts_with]->(c:LightIonChannel {label:'KCNQ3'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS proteinLabel LIMIT 100

title: A5
query: List all biological processes the protein 'CFTR' is involved in.

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'CFTR'})-[:has_biological_process]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) RETURN DISTINCT bp.label LIMIT 100

query: Retrieve all molecular functions associated with the dark ion channel 'KCNG3'.

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (ic:DarkIonChannel {label: 'KCNG3'})<-[:hasMolecularFunction]-(mf:MolecularFunction) RETURN DISTINCT mf.label AS molecularFunction LIMIT 100)

query: Retrieve all ions associated with the light ion channel 'HTR3E'.

query: Find all proteins that have the PTM 'Prkaa2'

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPTM]->(t:PTM {label: 'Prkaa2'}) RETURN p.label AS label UNION MATCH (lk:LightKinase)-[:hasPTM]->(t:PTM {label: 'Prkaa2'}) RETURN lk.label AS label UNION MATCH (dk:DarkKinase)-[:hasPTM]->(t:PTM {label: 'Prkaa2'}) RETURN dk.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPTM]->(ptm:PTM) WHERE ptm.label = 'Prkaa2' RETURN DISTINCT p.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPTM]->(ptm:PTM {label: 'Prkaa2'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.label LIMIT 100

title: A11
query: List all dark ion channels that interact with the 'CACNB1' protein.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (di:DarkIonChannel)-[:interact]-(p:Protein {label: 'CACNB1'}) RETURN DISTINCT di.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label:'CACNB1'}), (d:DarkIonChannel) WHERE (p)-[:interact]->(d) OR (p)<-[:interact]-(d) RETURN DISTINCT d.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label:'CACNB1'}) MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)-[:interacts_with]->(p) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS DarkIonChannelLabel UNION MATCH (p:Protein {label:'CACNB1'}) MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)<-[:interacts_with]-(p) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS DarkIonChannelLabel LIMIT 100

title: A12
query: List all the ion channels from the family TRP.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (ic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family {label:'TRP'}) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS Channel UNION MATCH (ic:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family {label:'TRP'}) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS Channel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (ic)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family {label: 'TRP'}) WHERE ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (ic:LightIonChannel) RETURN DISTINCT ic.label LIMIT 100

title: A13
query: Which family has the largest number of dark ion channels?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (dc:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) WITH f, count(dc) AS channelCount ORDER BY channelCount DESC RETURN f.label AS family LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) WITH f, count(d) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN f.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group), (f:Family)-[:hasGroup]->(g) RETURN f.label AS family, count(DISTINCT d) AS numDarkIonChannels ORDER BY numDarkIonChannels DESC LIMIT 100

title: A14
query: List all dark ion channels that belong to the family labeled 'Unclassified'.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family {label: 'Unclassified'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS DarkIonChannelLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) WHERE f.label = 'Unclassified' RETURN DISTINCT c.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel) MATCH (d)-[:BelongsToFamily]->(f:Family {label: 'Unclassified'}) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS DarkIonChannelLabel LIMIT 100

title: A15
query: What molecular functions are associated with light ion channels that belong to the 'GABA' family?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (lit:LightIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family) WHERE fam.label CONTAINS "GABA" MATCH (lit)-[:hasMolecularFunction]->(mf:MolecularFunction) RETURN DISTINCT mf.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family) WHERE fam.label CONTAINS 'GABA' MATCH (lic)-[:hasMolecularFunction]->(mf:MolecularFunction) RETURN DISTINCT mf.label AS MolecularFunction LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (l:LightIonChannel)-[:belongsTo]->(f:Family) WHERE f.label CONTAINS 'GABA' MATCH (l)-[:hasMolecularFunction]->(mf:MolecularFunction) RETURN DISTINCT mf.label AS molecularFunction LIMIT 100

title: A16
query: List all the ions and gating mechanisms for the 'K' family of dark ion channels.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (c:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) WHERE f.label = 'K' MATCH (c)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) MATCH (c)-[:hasGateMechanism]->(g:GateMechanism) RETURN DISTINCT i.label AS Ion, g.label AS GateMechanism LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (dc:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family) WHERE fam.label = 'K' MATCH (dc)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) MATCH (dc)-[:hasGateMechanism]->(g:GateMechanism) RETURN DISTINCT i.label AS Ion, g.label AS Gate LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)-[:part_of_family]->(f:Family) WHERE f.label = 'K' WITH DISTINCT d MATCH (d)-[:part_of_unit]->(u:IonChannelUnit),       (u)-[:part_of_gate]->(g:GateMechanism) RETURN DISTINCT u.label AS ion, g.label AS gatingMechanism LIMIT 100

query: Find all proteins involved in the 'Fatty acid metabolism' pathway.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway {label:'Fatty acid metabolism'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE pw.label = 'Fatty acid metabolism' RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS proteinLabel LIMIT 100

title: B1

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'CFTR'})-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasBiologicalProcess]->(bp) RETURN DISTINCT lic.label AS lightIonChannel LIMIT 100

title: B2
query: Find all dark ion channels that are involved in the same pathway as the 'CACNG6' dark ion channel.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (d1:DarkIonChannel {label:'CACNG6'})-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) MATCH (d2:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasPathway]->(p) WHERE d2 <> d1 RETURN DISTINCT d2.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:DarkIonChannel {label:"CACNG6"})-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel)-[:hasPathway]->(p) WHERE d <> c RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS label LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (target:DarkIonChannel {label:'CACNG6'}) MATCH (target)-[:Pathway]->(p:Pathway) MATCH (c:DarkIonChannel)-[:Pathway]->(p) WHERE c.label <> 'CACNG6' RETURN DISTINCT c.label LIMIT 100;

title: B3
query: Find all diseases that are linked to proteins that bind to the 'ferric oxide' chemical.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'ferric oxide'})-[:assoWithGene]->(p) MATCH (p)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS disease LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'ferric oxide'})-[:assoWithGene]->(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT d.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (c:Chemical {label:'ferric oxide'})<-[:binds]-(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:is_linked_to_diseases]->(d:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT d.label AS diseaseLabel LIMIT 100

title: B4
query: Find all functional domains that the protein 'CFTR' shares with other proteins.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p:Protein {label:'CFTR'}), (p)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain)  MATCH (other)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd)  WHERE id(other) <> id(p)  RETURN DISTINCT fd.label  LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (cftr:Protein {label: 'CFTR'})-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain)<-[:hasFunctionalDomain]-(other:Protein) WHERE ID(other) <> ID(cftr) RETURN DISTINCT fd.label AS domain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'CFTR'})-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) MATCH (other:Protein)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd) WHERE p <> other RETURN DISTINCT fd.label AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100;

title: B5
query: Find all the proteins that are associated with the same pathways and conduct the same ions as the protein 'KCNG3'.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (k:Protein {label:'KCNG3'}) MATCH (k)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw) MATCH (k)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion:Ion) MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ion) RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS proteinLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (p)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:hasIonAsso]->(io:Ion) MATCH (q:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw) MATCH (q)-[:hasIonAsso]->(io) WHERE id(q) <> id(p) RETURN DISTINCT q.label AS Protein LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label:'KCNG3'})-[:has_pathway]->(pw:Pathway) MATCH (p)-[:conducts]->(ion:Ion) MATCH (pr:Protein)-[:has_pathway]->(pw) MATCH (pr)-[:conducts]->(ion) RETURN DISTINCT pr.label AS proteinLabel LIMIT 100

title: B6
query: List all biological processes that are connected to chemicals associated with the protein 'TRPM8'.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (c:Chemical)-[:assoWithGene]->(p:Protein {label: 'TRPM8'}),       (c)-[:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) RETURN DISTINCT bp.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'TRPM8'}),       (c:Chemical)-[:assoWithGene]->(p),       (c)-[:assoWithBiologicalProcess]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) RETURN DISTINCT bp.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'TRPM8'}) MATCH (p)-[:hasProtein]->(cd:Chemical) MATCH (cd)-[:associatedWith]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) RETURN DISTINCT bp.label AS BiologicalProcess LIMIT 100

title: B7
query: Identify all pathways that connect the dark ion channel 'CACNG3' to diseases through proteins implicated in those diseases.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (d:DarkIonChannel {label: 'CACNG3'})-[:hasPathway]->(pth:Pathway) MATCH (pr)-[:hasPathway]->(pth) WHERE id(pr) <> id(d) MATCH (pr)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(dis:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT pth.label AS pathway, dis.label AS disease LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:DarkIonChannel {label: 'CACNG3'}) MATCH (c)-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) MATCH (pro)-[:hasPathway]->(p) WHERE pro <> c MATCH (pro)-[:implicatedInDisease]->(d:Disease) RETURN DISTINCT p.label AS pathwayLabel, d.label AS diseaseLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (pDark:DarkIonChannel {label:'CACNG3'}) MATCH (pDark)-[:hasProteinImplicationInDisease*1..2]->(disease:Disease) MATCH (pDark)-[pathRel:connects*1..2]->(disease) RETURN DISTINCT disease.label AS disease, pathRel.label AS pathways;

query: Retrieve the functional domains of proteins that are associated with the chemical 'ferric oxide'.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (c:Chemical {label:'ferric oxide'})-[:assoWithGene]->(p) WHERE p:Protein OR p:LightIonChannel OR p:DarkIonChannel OR p:LightKinase OR p:DarkKinase MATCH (p)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT fd.label LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (c:Chemical {label: 'ferric oxide'})-[:assoWithGene]->(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT fd.label AS FunctionalDomainLabel LIMIT 100

title: C1
query: Which family and group does the ion channel 'HTR3E' belong to?

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (p)-[:hasFamily]->(fam:Family) MATCH (p)-[:hasGroup]->(grp:Group) WHERE p.label = 'HTR3E' RETURN DISTINCT fam.label AS family, grp.label AS group LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'HTR3E'}) MATCH (p)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) MATCH (p)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) RETURN DISTINCT f.label AS family, g.label AS group LIMIT 100;
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (i:LightIonChannel)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) MATCH (i:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) WHERE i.label = 'HTR3E' RETURN DISTINCT f.label AS family, g.label AS group LIMIT 100;

title: C2
query: Find all ion channels that are connected to the 'Neuronal System' pathway through interacting proteins.

ablation_results.oracle: MATCH (pw:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (p1)-[:hasPathway]->(pw) MATCH (p1)-[:interact]-(p2) WHERE p2:LightIonChannel OR p2:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT p2.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (ic:LightIonChannel)-[:interact]->(p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE pw.label = 'Neuronal System' RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS label UNION MATCH (ic:DarkIonChannel)-[:interact]->(p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE pw.label = 'Neuronal System' RETURN DISTINCT ic.label AS label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (path:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (path)-[:contains]->(ptm:PTM) MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:hasPtm]->(ptm) MATCH (chan:LightIonChannel | DarkIonChannel)-[:interacts_with]->(prot) RETURN DISTINCT chan.label AS IonChannelLabel;

title: C3
query: List the light ion channels in the Chloride channels group and their respective functional domains.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (lc:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) WHERE g.label = 'Chloride channels' MATCH (lc)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN DISTINCT lc.label AS ChannelLabel, fd.label AS FunctionalDomainLabel LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) WHERE g.label = 'Chloride channels' RETURN DISTINCT lic.label AS LightIonChannel LIMIT 100;

ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (c:Chemical {label:'Ozone'})-[:associatedWith]->(p:Protein) MATCH (p)-[:r]->(bp:BiologicalProcess) MATCH (p)-[:hasProperty]->(i:Ion) RETURN DISTINCT i.label AS Ion LIMIT 100
